notes: ETH uses vendor-confirmed 32MB flash, not the 16MB example.
JC4880 SD LDO4 uses passthrough; GPIO45 is not populated in the reference schematic.
Bare ETH and M3 profiles explicitly require the ECA20-MHA1-I HDMI bridge, not an unspecified DSI panel.
4B SDIO Wi-Fi follows the supplied example; vendor documentation has a conflicting signal summary, so hardware confirmation is required.
Tab5 profile targets the original ILI9881C/GT911 revision only.
JC8012 GSL3680 source is pinned in components/gsl3680/UPSTREAM.json.
Espressif Function EV v1.5.2 with supplied 7-inch EK79007/GT911; P4X rev3 is separate.
Olimex profile follows PCB rev D1 and iperf sdkconfig: IP101 PHY address1, no Wi-Fi or codec.
DFRobot FireBeetle 2 is specifically ESP32-P4 SKU DFR1172, not its C5/C6/S3 relatives.
All three profiles use active-low GPIO45 SD power from PMOS gate wiring.
Olimex and FireBeetle HDMI profiles require ECA20-MHA1-I with a board-specific adapter; no onboard audio or HDMI audio.

M3 10.1-inch display variant: user-supplied ESP-Tab10.1-Demo YAML 2026-10-16. Native 800x1280 JD9365 rotated 270 degrees, GT911 swap_xy/mirror_x, IP101 Ethernet GPIO31/52/50/51 address1, 16MB DIO flash at 400MHz, LDO3 2.5V and LDO4 2.7V, GPIO53 speaker amplifier. Hardware untested; does not alter the HDMI M3 profile.

CPU revision correction 2026-10-16: 400MHz requires P4 revision 3.0/X. Early revision 0/1 profiles, including M3 LCD101, use 360MHz. The supplied M3 example 400MHz value is not used by the early-silicon build.

JC1060P470_I_W_Y user reference audited 2026-10-16: separate jc1060-iwy Ethernet profile with LCD reset0, PA11, LDO4 2.7V, I2C7/8 external pull-ups, IP101 MDC31/MDIO52/clock50/power51 address1, GT911 polling.
